Nike is set to launch the Vegam Run, its first running shoe designed specifically for India, on November 1.
The sportswear maker claims the shoe is aimed at the country’s growing running community and is designed for everyday training and regular wear.
Nike said it worked with Indian athletes during the design process, and incorporated key insights on running, training and everyday use into the shoe’s development.
The company claims it built this show, from design to product, in less than two months — 55 days to be precise.
The Vegam Run will be available across India from November 1, with additional international markets expected to follow in 2027. It will be priced at ₹3,795.
